name: Athena OS
headline: Train AI on all your data.
definition: Athena OS is an open-source, self-hosted no-code AI training and visual inspection platform across photos, video, audio, handwriting, documents, signals, and spreadsheets. Apache-2.0.
description: Train AI on all your data: photos, audio, handwriting, documents, signals, and spreadsheets. Self-hosted, no-code, Apache-2.0.
features: No-code AI setup across Photos, Sounds, Handwriting, Spreadsheets, Text notes, and Sensors
Ask plain-language questions on photos or 6-frame video clips with counts and marked regions
Step-by-step guided workflow from sample upload to accuracy check and real-world review
Built-in private Qwen AI by default, or connect your own cloud or local AI

founder.name: Ts. Dominic Mathew
founder.summary: Ts. Dominic Mathew is Co-Founder and CTO of Stratetics Experts. He publishes Athena OS as open-source multimodal AI training tooling and builds Inspec-Ther for solar inspection.

athenaVision.name: Athena Vision
athenaVision.summary: In-house Segment and Detect models for assisted annotation: label one picture, then review AI drafts on the rest. Bounding boxes, masks, and export to COCO, YOLO or VOC. This is the vision stack behind Inspec-Ther.

inspecTher.name: Inspec-Ther
inspecTher.description: AI-driven thermal inspection of solar PV assets.
inspecTher.modelNote: Inspec-Ther is the solar inspection product. Athena Vision (Segment and Detect) is the in-house vision stack behind it. This page is the open-source Athena OS toolkit, not the hosted Inspec-Ther app.

faq.a: Athena OS is an open-source, self-hosted AI training and inspection platform. Today you can inspect photos or 6-frame clips in plain words and train custom models across images, audio clips, handwriting, spreadsheets, text, and sensor signals — with multi-sensor fusion and edge deployment designed to run right on your site.

faq.q: Do I need to write code?
faq.a: No. Pick what you want Athena to do, point out a few examples visually, and read results in plain English — no coding or technical jargon needed.
On your own office computer, server, or small site box right next to your cameras and machines. Open-source Apache-2.0 — your data stays in your building.
It includes built-in private Qwen AI for offline use, or you can connect OpenAI, Google Gemini, OpenRouter, or a local server like Ollama or LM Studio.
Ts. Dominic Mathew, Co-Founder and CTO of Stratetics Experts. His portfolio is dominic.strateticsxp.com.

faq.q: How does this relate to Inspec-Ther?
faq.a: Inspec-Ther is the solar PV thermal inspection product at inspec-ther.com. The in-house vision stack behind it is Athena Vision (Segment and Detect). Athena OS on this page is the open-source toolkit, not the hosted Inspec-Ther app.
